river-tarn.title: The River Tarn
river-tarn.summary: Slow and wide, fed by a moor that does not hold water.
river-tarn.summary_html: Slow and wide, fed by a moor that does not hold water.
river-tarn.html:
The Tarn is a lowland river with an upland temper. It drains a moor of thin peat over rock, so rain that falls on the watershed is in the channel the same day rather than a week later.

Fords are therefore a question about the last two days of weather rather than about the river.
